name: @fyeeme/pi-todo
description: File-based todos for pi — a todo tool (list, list-all, get, create, update, append, delete, claim, release) over markdown files in .pi/todos with per-todo locks and garbage collection, plus a /todos interactive manager. Rewritten from mitsuhiko/agent-stuf
